newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares marginally lower in late IBIS trade.
newsitem.headline: German shares marginally lower in late IBIS trade.

text.p: 1439 GMT - German shares lose some ground in late electronic trade, as indecisive early trade on Wall Street provides no markers for the German market. Dealers say next week's DAX options expiry deadline braking market gains. Widespread uncertainty about monetary union and German political situation persists.
* 30-share IBIS DAX down 6.38 points at 3,664.78 points.
* June DTB DAX futures down four points at 3,669.
* Deutsche Telekom up, driven by technical signals.
* Gehe 2.20 percent lower despite upbeat H1 sales, profits outlook.
